name: Ternary 3-Component Composition Simplex Plot
why_distinct: Equilateral triangle barycentric coordinate system plotting 3-part ratios summing to 100% (e.g. PvE vs PvP vs Social playtime share or Paid vs Organic vs Referral mix) with optional KDE density contours — zero bar/quadrant chrome.

name: Interactive 3D Surface & Volatility Terrain (ECharts GL)
why_distinct: Rotatable WebGL 3D continuous topographic surface for option-volatility smiles, latency-vs-load-vs-concurrency surfaces, or price-elasticity profit peaks.

name: Dorling Proportional-Circle Geographic Cartogram
why_distinct: Replaces distorted tiny/huge land polygons with non-overlapping force-packed proportional circles anchored near geographic centroids, eliminating visual bias from low-population large states/countries.

name: Hierarchical Edge-Bundling Dependency Wheel
why_distinct: Circular hierarchical leaf layout with tension-adjustable B-spline bundled edges showing incoming vs outgoing service/module dependencies cleanly at 100+ nodes without hairball clutter.

name: Proportional Waffle & Isotype Unit Matrix
why_distinct: Clean 10x10 or custom-grid unit pictogram blocks representing exact part-to-whole shares with zero noisy axes — ideal for boardroom storytelling and conversion rates.

name: 2D Kernel Density Contour Topography Map
engine: D3.js v7 d3-contour + Canvas Scatter Overlay
why_distinct: Continuous topographic elevation bands (isolines) revealing multi-modal bivariate clusters across 5,000+ raw points without scatter overplotting.

name: 24-Hour Polar Clock & Cyclical Wind-Rose
why_distinct: Circular 24-hour / 12-month radial rose plotting cyclical peak intensity and segmented composition around a true clock face.

name: Linear Arc Sequence & Hop Distance Diagram
why_distinct: Orders nodes along a single horizontal spine with forward hops arcing above and backward/loopback hops arcing below, exposing regressions and rework cycles instantly.

name: Collision-Free Force Beeswarm Dot Strip
why_distinct: Exact-value collision-resolved dot swarms (no artificial jitter) scaled by bubble size so every individual deal, account, or anomaly is inspectable without overlapping.

name: Zoomable Hierarchical Icicle Partition Browser
why_distinct: Full-width stacked orthogonal partition bands with click-to-zoom ancestry strips — dramatically easier to read exact text labels and relative widths than nested treemaps.

name: Interactive What-If Monte Carlo Fan Simulator
why_distinct: Live in-tile interactive sliders (growth rate, churn delta, pricing lift) that re-simulate 500 client-side Monte Carlo trajectories at 60 FPS with P10/P50/P90 probability cones.

name: Equal-Area Hex-Tile US State Cartogram
why_distinct: Every US state + DC rendered as an identical-size hexagon in approximate geographic position, with optional micro-sparkline or KPI number inside every hex so small states (RI, DE, DC, MA) are equally legible.
